page.overview:
Who is Benett?

Benett was a Human male who lived in the city of Anchorhead on the planet Tatooine during the Cold War. When Anchorhead was the target of terrorist attacks using bomb-carrying local droids, Benett's leg was injured in an explosion, but he and his neighbor Cana were defended from additional droids by Havoc Squad.
